summary: Acme AI: Feb 2026 invoice did not apply contracted service credits as expected
description:
Issue summary:
Acme AI reports their Feb 2026 invoice did not reflect a previously approved credit (service credit) that they expected to reduce the invoice balance.

Customer expectation:
- A $25,000 service credit (approved in late Jan) should apply to the next eligible invoice.
- Customer expected the credit to be applied automatically and appear as a credit line item and reduced amount due.

Actual behavior:
- Feb 2026 invoice was issued at full amount (no credit line item).
- Customer Portal shows credit balance, but Feb invoice PDF and invoice email did not show it applied.

Impact:
- Customer is blocking payment while discrepancy is unresolved.
- Potential renewal risk (customer flagged as "finance escalation" by AE).

Key artifacts (internal):
- Billing account: acct_acme_ai_0147
- Invoice: INV-2026-02-ACME-88311 (issued 2026-02-10)
- Credit grant record: CR-ACME-2026-01-1172 ($25,000)
- Slack thread: #support 1770127744 (credits application incorrect on invoice)

Requested outcome:
- Confirm credit applicability to Feb invoice.
- If eligible: issue correction (credit memo / apply to open invoice) with Finance sign-off and provide updated documentation to customer.
- If not eligible: provide contract-aligned explanation and next steps.
investigation_notes:
Triage notes (Support + Billing Hooks + Finance):
1) Verified credit exists in billing ledger:
- Credit grant CR-ACME-2026-01-1172 created 2026-01-29 18:42 PT.
- Status: active, remaining_amount: $25,000.
- Applies_to: Hosted API usage only (metered charges), excludes: Dedicated capacity minimum commit and taxes.

2) Verified Feb invoice composition:
- Invoice INV-2026-02-ACME-88311 includes:
  - Hosted API usage line items (metered)
  - Dedicated monthly commit line item (non-metered)
  - Sales tax line item

3) Why credit did not apply:
- The credit is configured to apply only to Hosted API metered charges.
- Our invoice generator currently applies credits after usage aggregation but before finalization; however, for this invoice the Hosted API usage subtotal was $0.00 due to a mid-cycle plan change that moved Hosted API usage to a different billing group (acct sub-ledger) while Dedicated remained on the main invoice.
- Result: credit remained unused (no eligible Hosted API line items on INV-2026-02-ACME-88311), even though customer expected it to reduce the total invoice amount.

4) Confirmed the plan change details:
- Acme org had a billing admin request on 2026-02-03 to consolidate projects and move Hosted API charges to a new cost center export.
- That change created a second billing group used for Hosted API usage, but invoice finalization stayed on the Dedicated group for Feb.

5) Coordination with Finance/RevRec:
- Emily Stone confirmed we should not retroactively regenerate a posted invoice without documented approval.
- Finance preference: issue a credit memo tied to the Feb invoice OR apply the credit to the next invoice that contains Hosted API usage for the correct billing group, with customer acknowledgement.

Open questions resolved during investigation:
- Not a metering bug (tokens counted correctly); this is credit applicability + billing-group mapping behavior.
- Credit is not expired; it is active and can be applied forward.

References:
- Internal process context: month-end close freeze window (see Slack: 1770061189).
resolution:
Resolution (approved by Finance on 2026-02-20):
- Created an invoice-level adjustment (credit memo) CM-ACME-2026-02-0097 for $25,000 applied against INV-2026-02-ACME-88311.
- Re-issued an updated invoice PDF showing the credit memo reference and updated amount due.
- Updated customer portal balance to reflect applied amount.

Remediation steps taken:
1) Finance (Emily Stone) posted CM-ACME-2026-02-0097 in the billing ledger with audit note referencing this ticket.
2) Billing (Cole Summers) triggered an invoice document regeneration job for INV-2026-02-ACME-88311 (document-only; no usage recompute) to include the adjustment line.
3) Support sent customer the updated invoice PDF + confirmation of the credit memo and how it will appear in their records.

Preventative actions / follow-ups:
- Add a pre-invoice validation check: if an account has an active credit grant, verify the credit applies to the billing group being invoiced OR warn the invoice preview owner.
- Document "credit applicability vs billing group" in internal credits policy + Sales FAQ.

Customer confirmation:
- Customer confirmed receipt of updated invoice on 2026-02-21 and proceeded with payment workflow.

Final status:
- Closed after payment was unblocked and customer acknowledged correction.
customer_communication:
Customer-facing summary sent (2026-02-21):
- We confirmed the $25,000 credit was active, but it was configured to apply to Hosted API metered usage only.
- Your Feb invoice was generated under the Dedicated billing group after your billing-group change, and the Hosted API usage was billed under a separate group, so the credit did not automatically apply to that invoice.
- To resolve quickly, we issued a $25,000 credit memo against the Feb invoice and provided an updated invoice PDF reflecting the reduced amount due.
- Going forward, we can help align credits to the correct billing group to ensure automatic application on future invoices.

Attachments provided:
- Updated invoice PDF (INV-2026-02-ACME-88311)
- Credit memo reference (CM-ACME-2026-02-0097)

Dispute handling:
- No retroactive usage changes were made; this was a billing adjustment with Finance approval and audit trail.
internal_followups:
Follow-ups:
- Create internal support request to tighten credit application logic across billing groups and improve invoice preview warnings (owner: Cole Summers).
- Update Sales Enablement FAQ entry: "Do credits apply to Dedicated commits?" and "How do credits behave if billing groups/projects change?" (owner: Jordan Blake + Elliot Price).
- Add this scenario to reconciliation playbook under "Credits present but not applied" (owner: Emily Stone).

Notes:
- This ticket is part of the broader billing integrity initiative; keep evidence for audit trail (Finance/RevRec).
